top25_must_pass_status.must_preserve: Long clean schema recipe with sauce, cheese, noodles, assembly, and bake stages.
Baking quantities and temperature from a clean schema page.
Brine versus roasting ingredients and timing.
Recipe card content while ignoring embedded video UI.
Source volume and gram weights for bread ingredients.
Tangzhong section separate from dough.
Repeated cake/frosting ingredients with correct direction refs.
Long-blog import with chill time and metric alternates.
Strawberry reduction, cake, and frosting components.
Dough, filling, and icing sections plus rise times.
Source-grounded banana tips as notes, not hallucinated additions.
Fermentation and bake ranges without collapsing them.
Metric weights, chocolate type/percentage, and brownie doneness cues.
Keep substitutions and toppings out of the required ingredient list.
Ignore cost metadata; preserve one-pot liquid/pasta ratios.
Metric/gas mark UK cake data.
Marinade/sauce stages and spice quantities.
Marinade ingredients and serving suggestions separated.
US and metric quantities without duplicate display.
Primary recipe versus variations.
Special-diet substitutions as source-grounded notes.
Marinade/sauce sections and Chinese pantry names.
Japanese pantry terms and egg/dashi quantities.
Ramen components and linked sub-recipe notes.
Large-batch dough, filling, icing, and yield.

Report attempted pass rate, true fail rate, and total manifest coverage separately so skipped cases do not inflate pass rate.
Add --with-ai-fallback as the explicit opt-in flag for paid/AI fallback runs.
Add confidence by source type plus top 10 nightmare status to the generated reports.
